'''2007 Dantooine Regionals Joseph Graham LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2007 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' DBO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
